WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_start,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS range_end,
         LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS elapsed_end
), periods AS (
  SELECT bucket, GREATEST(bucket, b.range_start) AS period_start,
         LEAST(bucket + interval '15 minutes', b.range_end) AS period_end,
         b.elapsed_end
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    date_bin(interval '15 minutes', b.range_start, timestamptz '1970-01-01 00:00Z'),
    b.range_end - interval '1 microsecond', interval '15 minutes'
  ) AS bucket
  WHERE b.range_end > b.range_start
), counts AS (
  SELECT date_bin(interval '15 minutes', e.event_at, timestamptz '1970-01-01 00:00Z') AS bucket,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'departure') AS departures,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'arrival') AS arrivals
  FROM flight_events e CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE e.airport = 'EKCH'
    AND e.event_at >= b.range_start AND e.event_at < b.elapsed_end
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(p.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date",
       (extract(hour FROM p.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') * 60 +
        extract(minute FROM p.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::integer AS "Minute",
       CASE WHEN p.period_start < p.elapsed_end THEN COALESCE(c.departures, 0) END AS "Departures",
       CASE WHEN p.period_start < p.elapsed_end THEN COALESCE(c.arrivals, 0) END AS "Arrivals",
       (p.period_start < p.elapsed_end)::integer AS "Elapsed",
       (extract(epoch FROM p.period_start) * 1000)::double precision AS "Period start",
       (extract(epoch FROM p.period_end) * 1000)::double precision AS "Period end",
       CASE WHEN p.period_start < p.elapsed_end THEN
         (extract(epoch FROM LEAST(p.period_end, p.elapsed_end)) * 1000)::double precision
       END AS "Observed until"
FROM periods p LEFT JOIN counts c USING (bucket)
ORDER BY p.bucket

panels.title: Traffic heatmap · 15-minute intervals (UTC)
panels.description: Detected EKCH movements in the selected range, in UTC 15-minute intervals. Only dates and clock intervals overlapping the selection are shown; each date stays separate. Departures left (green), arrivals right (orange), with one shared intensity scale. Use the bottom slider to zoom into intervals; long date ranges have a vertical slider. Quiet elapsed intervals show zero; grey cross-date gaps are outside the range, outlines are future. Zero does not prove collector coverage. Boundary intervals are clipped to the selection.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_start,
         LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS range_end
), buckets AS (
  SELECT bucket, GREATEST(bucket, b.range_start) AS period_start,
         LEAST(bucket + interval '15 minutes', b.range_end) AS period_end
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    date_bin(interval '15 minutes', b.range_start, timestamptz '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'),
    b.range_end - interval '1 microsecond', interval '15 minutes'
  ) AS bucket
  WHERE b.range_end > b.range_start
), counts AS (
  SELECT date_bin(interval '15 minutes', e.event_at, timestamptz '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') AS bucket,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'departure') AS departures,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'arrival') AS arrivals
  FROM flight_events e CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE e.airport = 'EKCH'
    AND e.event_at >= b.range_start AND e.event_at < b.range_end
  GROUP BY 1
), periods AS (
  SELECT b.period_start, b.period_end,
         COALESCE(c.departures, 0) AS departures,
         COALESCE(c.arrivals, 0) AS arrivals
  FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN counts c USING (bucket)
)
SELECT period_start AS "time", departures::double precision AS "Departures",
       arrivals::double precision AS "Arrivals"
FROM periods ORDER BY period_start

panels.title: Traffic timeline · movements per 15 minutes
panels.description: Detected EKCH departures (blue) and arrivals (green), stacked in UTC quarter-hour bins. Empty elapsed intervals contain zero recorded events; future intervals are not plotted. First/last bins may be partial. Zero does not establish that the collector had complete coverage.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_start,
         LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS range_end
), increments AS (
  SELECT e.event_at,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'departure') AS departures,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'arrival') AS arrivals
  FROM flight_events e CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE e.airport = 'EKCH'
    AND e.event_at >= b.range_start AND e.event_at < b.range_end
  GROUP BY e.event_at
), times AS (
  SELECT range_start AS t FROM bounds WHERE range_end > range_start
  UNION SELECT event_at FROM increments
  UNION SELECT range_end FROM bounds WHERE range_end > range_start
)
SELECT t AS "time",
       sum(COALESCE(i.departures, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::double precision AS "Departures",
       sum(COALESCE(i.arrivals, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::double precision AS "Arrivals"
FROM times LEFT JOIN increments i ON i.event_at = times.t
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Accumulated departures and arrivals
panels.description: Running totals of detected EKCH movements from the selected range start. Each step occurs at the event timestamp; quiet periods stay flat. The final values equal the accumulated stat panels. Counts stop at now when the selected range extends into the future.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_start,
         LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS range_end
)
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(btrim(e.destination)), ''), 'Unknown') AS "Destination",
       count(*) AS "Departures"
FROM flight_events e CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE e.airport = 'EKCH'
    AND e.event_at >= b.range_start AND e.event_at < b.range_end AND e.event_type = 'departure'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Departures" DESC, "Destination" ASC LIMIT 10

WITH latest AS (SELECT id FROM snapshots ORDER BY feed_updated_at DESC LIMIT 1), positions AS (SELECT callsign, name, frequency, 'Controller' AS kind FROM controllers WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM latest) AND callsign ~ '^(EKCH|EKDK)_' UNION ALL SELECT callsign, name, frequency, 'ATIS' AS kind FROM atis WHERE snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM latest) AND callsign LIKE 'EKCH_%') SELECT kind AS "Type", callsign AS "Callsign", name AS "Name", frequency AS "Frequency" FROM positions ORDER BY kind, callsign
